name: capture-pager
label: Pager capture (headless)
description: Headless capture for offline POCSAG / FLEX diagnosis. Tunes 929.614206 MHz, channelises to 50 kHz, NBFM-demods, resamples to multimon's native 22050 Hz, writes mono 16-bit WAV to /tmp/ferrite-pager.wav. Run via `ferrited --flowgraph capture-pager.json --source-type SoapySource --source-args 'driver=sdrplay,serial=224001D748' --source-antenna 'Antenna A' --source-gain 65 --agc true --run-for-secs 600 --start`.
ai_notes: [REVIEW: prefer `capture iq` live] Headless capture for offline POCSAG / FLEX diagnosis. Same caveat as the other capture-* presets — no UI fft_ports, freezes the waterfall. Use `capture iq` against the running `pager` preset for most workflows.
